source_record.description:
At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers.

From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.

As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.

Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.

We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

Brevo’s Growth Marketing team works to make Brevo one of the most trusted and frequently recommended solutions across traditional search, AI platforms, creators, affiliates, and review sites.

We’re looking for a structured, curious, and detail-oriented working student to support the operational side of this work. You will help keep our content processes, affiliate program, and recurring marketing operations accurate and moving.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who wants hands-on experience in digital and growth marketing while learning how SEO, AI visibility, content, partnerships, and performance data work together in an international SaaS company.


Your Impact at Brevo:
Content and website operations:
  • Create, upload, format, and update content in our content management system
  • Coordinate content publication across different markets and languages
  • Check pages for formatting, links, metadata, tracking, and other editorial requirements
  • Support updates to existing blog articles, landing pages, and other website content
  • Maintain content trackers and keep publication statuses accurate
  • Flag inconsistencies, missing information, or quality issues to the appropriate team member
  • Help document and improve repeatable content workflows

    • Affiliate program operations:

  • Review new affiliate applications using established criteria
  • Carry out recurring quality and compliance checks across affiliate accounts
  • Support the identification of suspicious activity, low-quality traffic, and potential affiliate fraud
  • Keep affiliate records, partner statuses, and internal documentation up to date
  • Help with recurring commission and performance checks
  • Escalate unusual cases to the responsible affiliate manager

    • Who you are:
  • You are currently enrolled in a university program in marketing, business, communications, media, languages, or a related field
  • You are available for up to 20 hours per week
  • You have strong organizational skills and excellent attention to detail
  • You enjoy structured work and take pride in keeping information accurate
  • You are comfortable working with spreadsheets, digital tools, and repeatable processes
  • You can follow clear guidelines while recognizing when something needs to be escalated
  • You communicate clearly and are comfortable working with colleagues across different countries and functions
  • You are proactive, dependable, and willing to take ownership of operational tasks
  • You are fluent in written and spoken English
    •  
    Nice to have:
  • Initial experience in digital marketing, content management, SEO, affiliate marketing, or e-commerce
  • Familiarity with a content management system such as WordPress
  • Confidence working with Google Sheets or Excel
  • An interest in AI tools and how people discover brands through platforms such as ChatGPT and Google
  • Knowledge of German, French, or another European language
    •  
    You do not need to know all our tools before joining. Training and clear processes will be provided.

    Why people love working at Brevo:
  • A place to grow, together: Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighbourhood; Free fruits & drinks & Snacks, Pizza Wednesdays, Monthly breakfasts & many other events and fun activities.
  • Practical perks for everyday balance: 125 Euro monthly budget to subsidize expenses like Lunch, Internet and well-being activities; Fully paid Urban Sports Club M Membership; Subsidized BVG ticket for public transportation; Budget to support your workspace at home.
  • Learning, every step of the way: Language learning with Babbel app & internal learning tools
  • Flexible for life: 2 days of remote work per week
  • A culture that cares: From inter-office trips to regular team events, there are plenty of ways to connect beyond your day-to-day. You’ll also find active social, green, and LGBTQIA+ committees

    • Our candidate journey:
  • Video call with the People & Impact Team
  • Hiring Manager interview 
  • On Site Case Study & last Interview
    • Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.
